name: tradingagents-cn
description: Multi-agent stock analysis report generator (TradingAgents-CN). Six analyst subagents (fundamentals/news/social/technical/bull/bear) analyze in parallel via file exchange, then an Assembler + risk-debate (trader/risk-manager) composes a professional PDF report. Triggers on requests to analyze a stock, generate a stock report, or ask for buy/sell recommendations. Requires python3.
